content: Behavior of Tasks in state BUDGET_EXHAUSTED Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_13000 Any functionallity (API or alarm action or expiry point) which tries to activate the Task (or set an Event of a Task) in state BUDGET_EXHAUSTED shall behave as if the Task would be in state READY except that BUDGET_EXHAUSTED can be left only as specified by [SWS_Os_00872].
